changed_in.5.3: Raises with `message` as the error object whatever its type, so a table reaches the catcher intact. 5.1 and 5.2 require the message to be a string — or a number, which they convert to one — and refuse anything else as a bad argument before the assertion's own failure is ever reported.
changed_in.5.5: An error object of `nil` is replaced by a string before it propagates, so a `nil` handed over as the message reaches a catcher as a string rather than as `nil`.
